preview.text: Bahrain and Bhutan meet in a T20 match at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval, where Bahrain has won all 6 of their recorded T20 meetings. Bahrain won the toss and chose to bat first on a ground where the usual first-innings score in the 10 recorded T20 matches is 125. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts about 31 degrees and up to an 86 per cent chance of rain.

summary.text: Bahrain won by 66 runs. BHR made 139-5, Junaid Aziz top-scoring with 45 off 35 balls; Gakul Ghalley took 1 for 14. BTN made 71-9, Namgang Chejay top-scoring with 26 off 31 balls; Ali Dawood took 4 for 8. Sides batting first at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval usually make about 125.
